jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Geneva
jobs.description: Very fine SME with some 60 employees, Tekhne SA is a company that values quality and dialogue both internally and with its clients and partners. Present in Lausanne, Geneva, Fribourg and Bern, it specialises in project management, construction management and delegated project ownership. Having won numerous prestigious architecture competitions, its references in terms of public and private works are as numerous as they are prestigious. To strengthen the Geneva branch , we have been mandated to search for a Senior Project Manager With experience in AMO and/or RMO Your responsibilities You support project owners in the management and realisation of their construction projects, from initial considerations to completion. Attuned to their expectations, you translate them into clear objectives and realistic solutions, while ensuring respect for qualitative, financial and time-related issues. You contribute to defining specifications, analyse project feasibility and surround yourself with the necessary expertise for their successful execution. As a true interface between the various stakeholders, you coordinate contractors, companies and partners, structure exchanges and ensure the smooth flow of information. Close to your clients, you advise them in their decision-making and provide regular reporting on the progress of operations. Both operational and strategic, you maintain a global vision of the projects at all times and actively contribute to their success. Your profile Reliable, committed and pragmatic, you have a strong sense of responsibility and are recognised for your ability to advance projects. Your listening skills, interpersonal ease and architectural sensitivity allow you to understand the expectations of your interlocutors and to unite partners with diverse interests. Endowed with natural leadership, you appreciate collaborative work while knowing how to take a step back and maintain a global and strategic vision. Holder of a higher education degree in architecture, engineering or an equivalent field, you have acquired confirmed experience in managing construction projects in Switzerland. Ideally with a background in AMO, RMO or a comparable role, you master the Swiss construction environment, its stakeholders, processes and administrative procedures.

jobs.title: Manager de projets senior - Genève
jobs.description: Très belle PME de quelques 60 collaborateurs, Tekhne SA est une société qui privilégie la qualité et le dialogue aussi bien en interne qu'avec ses clients et partenaires. Présente à Lausanne, Genève, Fribourg et Berne, elle est spécialisée dans le management de projets, le management de la construction et la maîtrise d'ouvrage déléguée. Maintes fois lauréate d'importants concours d’architecture, ses références en termes d’ouvrages publics et privés sont aussi nombreuses que prestigieuses. Afin de renforcer la succursale de Genève , nous sommes mandatés pour la recherche d'un·e Manager de projets senior Au bénéfice d'une expérience d'AMO et/ou RMO Vos responsabilités Vous accompagnez les maîtres d’ouvrage dans le pilotage et la réalisation de leurs projets de construction, depuis les premières réflexions jusqu’à leur concrétisation. À l’écoute de leurs attentes, vous les traduisez en objectifs clairs et en solutions réalistes, tout en veillant au respect des enjeux qualitatifs, financiers et temporels. Vous contribuez à la définition des cahiers des charges, analysez la faisabilité des projets et vous entourez des expertises nécessaires à leur bonne conduite. Véritable interface entre les différents acteurs, vous coordonnez les mandataires, entreprises et partenaires, structurez les échanges et veillez à la bonne circulation de l’information. Proche de vos clients, vous les conseillez dans leurs prises de décision et assurez un reporting régulier sur l’avancement des opérations. À la fois opérationnel·le et stratégique, vous conservez en permanence une vision globale des projets et contribuez activement à leur succès. Votre profil Fiable, engagé·e et pragmatique, vous avez le sens des responsabilités et êtes reconnu·e pour votre capacité à faire avancer les projets. Votre écoute, votre aisance relationnelle et votre sensibilité architecturale vous permettent de comprendre les attentes de vos interlocuteurs et de fédérer des partenaires aux intérêts multiples. Doté·e d’un leadership naturel, vous appréciez le travail collaboratif tout en sachant prendre du recul et conserver une vision globale et stratégique. Titulaire d’une formation supérieure en architecture, ingénierie ou dans un domaine équivalent, vous avez acquis une expérience confirmée dans la conduite de projets de construction en Suisse. Idéalement au bénéfice d’un parcours en AMO, RMO ou dans une fonction comparable, vous maîtrisez l’environnement suisse de la construction, ses acteurs, ses processus et ses démarches administratives.

jobs.title: Mobile Auxiliary Receptionist on Call - Geneva Region
jobs.description: As part of assignments for several of our clients, we are looking for mobile auxiliary receptionists with a variable activity rate to provide occasional cover and strengthen the reception teams at various sites located in the Geneva region. This is an on-call contract, requiring great flexibility and regular availability, particularly to sometimes intervene at short notice according to our clients' needs. Mobile Auxiliary Receptionist on Call - Geneva Region With us, you can make a difference. Your duties Ensure the physical and telephone reception of visitors, clients and colleagues Direct and inform visitors professionally Manage entries and exits (badges, registers, visitor announcements) Receive and distribute mail and parcels Handle calls, emails and various requests Ensure the impeccable upkeep of the reception area Collaborate with the various contacts present on site Adapt quickly to varied working environments and different client sites What characterises you. Your profile Previous experience in a similar role (reception, front desk, hospitality or customer service) is an asset Fluent French, spoken and written Very good level of English required Any other language is an advantage Excellent presentation and strong service orientation Very good interpersonal skills, discretion and courtesy Organisation, autonomy and reliability Proficiency with common IT tools Great flexibility and availability to work on call Mobility essential throughout the Geneva region Ability to integrate quickly into new working environments Here is what we offer you. We offer A varied activity within different professional environments Occasional assignments with well-known companies in the Geneva region A dynamic and enriching working environment An ideal experience for those seeking a flexible and diverse activity Equans Switzerland Facility Management AG As the leading provider of comprehensive building and energy solutions in Switzerland, we support the transformation and digitalisation of our clients and work together on the energy transition. Our services cover the entire lifecycle of buildings, sites, infrastructures and districts. As a market leader, our clients benefit from a full range of services from a single point of contact as well as integrated, team-based solutions for their projects. We have a presence throughout Switzerland and employ 6500 people across 140 sites. This enables us to efficiently implement projects both regionally and nationwide. In addition to building technology and automation as well as facility management, our offer also includes specialisations such as energy supply, transport, telecommunications, digitalisation and energy optimisation. We design, build and deliver projects ranging from smart buildings to future power plants and tunnels. Workplace Equans Switzerland Facility Management AG Rue Blavignac 10 1227 Carouge Your contact person Jessica ROULIN 076 372 54 80

jobs.description: Passionné(e) par l'univers de l'horlogerie et l'art de recevoir ? Rejoignez une Maison horlogère dynamique en tant que vendeur pour offrir une expérience client d'exception. Vendeur/se en horlogerie (Genève) A propos du rôle En tant que vendeur, vous serez en étroite collaboration avec le manager de la boutique, vous participerez activement à l'accueil d'une clientèle passionnée tout en assurant la gestion quotidienne du point de vente. Vous intégrerez une équipe jeune et à taille humaine au sein de laquelle vous pourrez développer une polyvalence précieuse en participant aussi bien au conseil client qu'à la gestion opérationnelle et aux événements exclusifs de la boutique. Nous vous proposons Un contrat en CDI à 100% et l'opportunité d'intégrer une équipe passionnée dans un cadre prestigieux. Tâches Le poste combine la vente directe en boutique de luxe, la gestion administrative et logistique, ainsi que le support à la communication digitale et événementielle. Accueil et conseil client: Accueillir une clientèle passionnée, raconter l'histoire des créations horlogères et établir des relations de confiance sur le long terme Gestion opérationnelle de la boutique: Participer au suivi des stocks et assurer le suivi administratif ainsi que le SAV Evènementiel et Communication: Contribuer à l'organisation des évènements de la boutique (afterworks, ateliers) et interagir avec la communauté sur les réseaux sociaux. Nous cherchons Maîtrise parfaite du français à l'oral comme à l'écrit Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit Expérience réussie dans le milieu du luxe ou l'hôtellerie Grand intérêt pour l'univers de l'horlogerie Bonne organisation et capacité d'apprentissage Aisance avec les outils informatiques et de gestion de caisse Un atout si vous possédez Maîtrise de l'arabe (Moyen-Orient) Connaissances spécifiques en horlogerie Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vos compétences personnelles sont les suivantes : Le sens du service Curieux Force de proposition Notre processus de recrutement Ce processus de recrutement est géré par Academic Work et notre client souhaite que toutes les questions concernant le poste soient adressées à Academic Work. Notre processus de sélection est continu et l'annonce peut être clôturée avant la fin du processus de recrutement si nous sommes passés à la phase suivante. Le processus comprend des tests qui sont des outils permettant de trouver le bon talent pour le bon poste, de favoriser l'égalité, la diversité et un processus équitable.

jobs.title: Account Manager for Academic Work Geneva!
jobs.description: Are you looking for a company ready to bet on your raw potential? Do you have a competitive spirit and see B2B development as a true strategic game? At Academic Work, your CV matters little; it’s your persuasive power and ambition that count. Come prove what you’re capable of: take on the challenge and pass the test! Account Manager for Academic Work Geneva! About the role Don't leave fit to chance! At Academic Work, we are experts in recruiting early-career professionals, with a clear ambition: to become THE leader in performance prediction. For nearly 30 years, we have been deploying our expertise across 6 countries. We continue to grow, which is why we are looking for two Account Managers to strengthen our Geneva team. Our Geneva office consists of 25 employees driven by a culture of ambition and more than 150 consultants whom we proudly support every month. What sets us apart? A strong corporate culture, unwavering commitment from our employees, and client satisfaction that motivates us daily to go further. So, ready to make a difference? Tasks The role of Account Manager is a clever mix of determination and strategic thinking. You constantly wear two hats: that of the Hunter, driving our expansion, and that of the Advisor, a trusted partner to business leaders. Your talent? Knowing how to open doors where others see obstacles, then adapting our expertise to market realities and available talent to create a unique solution. Specifically, you manage your activity around four axes: Prospecting and portfolio development: This is the heart of your mission. You build and manage your own client portfolio from A to Z. Cold calling is your daily lever to convince and secure strategic meetings with business leaders. Needs analysis and negotiation: You meet directors and managers to analyse their needs. You establish the profiles of sought candidates and lead pricing negotiations. Your goal is to convince your interlocutors of the value of our support to build long-term collaborations. Market expertise and internal synergy: Drawing on your field knowledge, you provide insightful advice to your clients. Once the need is identified, you work closely with our recruiters. Rigor and results: You are responsible for your performance. To ensure consistent results, you apply our working methods precisely, from first contact to closing the deal. We seek temperament, not a CV No matter your studies or professional background, we look for the following character traits: A sense of conviction: You do not hesitate to give your opinion, even in front of an authority figure. You prefer frank discussion over easy consensus. Unwavering resilience: Failure drives you to double your efforts. A "no" is never an end in itself, but the starting point to find another solution. A taste for achievement: You need to set challenges to move forward. You enjoy competition and seek an environment where your efforts are rewarded fairly. A natural curiosity: You like to dig into a subject to understand its roots. You ask the right questions to understand a problem before acting. A sense of autonomy: You appreciate the freedom to organise your days and demonstrate great personal discipline to achieve your goals. Requirements 0 to 3 years of experience after finishing your studies. No sales experience needed: we train you from A to Z through our AW Sales Academy . Fluent French and advanced English level (C1). Driving licence (category B). What we offer you A high-performers ecosystem: A demanding and stimulating environment where we lift each other up and celebrate successes together (trips, kick-offs). Impact as a true driver: You will have a direct impact on your clients’ business and the trajectory of young talents. Think big & make it happen: A progressive fixed salary and a completely uncapped commission system. Here, your ambition is the only limit. The AW Sales Academy: An elite programme (2 weeks onboarding + ongoing coaching) to transform your potential into B2B expertise. Strategic autonomy: Great freedom to manage your schedule and steer your client portfolio. Our predictive recruitment process We use science to validate your potential: Alva Labs tests (logic & personality): Your passport to the next step. Telephone contact (10 min) Interview with a recruiter Interview with Hiring Managers (including a case study to prepare) Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Senior Event Planning Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As Event Planning Manager , you accompany the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover and ensure that every event is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Precise creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Contact person for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operation. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-design of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, as well as at least three years of experience in hotel events or event planning, ideally focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with demanding guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and stylistically confident German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Account Manager in Sales & Event (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Rent.Group is a leading enabler of temporary ownership and circular use in Europe. With over 1,150 employees at 30 locations in 11 European countries and decades of experience, we are a driver of change – towards a comprehensive, circular sharing society with ecological and social benefits. With three divisions under one roof and a selection of over 6,000 product categories and more than 7 million individual items, we help our customers with interior and space design to always create the perfect feel-good atmosphere that inspires people – at events, trade fairs and in the office. With passion, creativity and the highest standards of quality, we support our customers throughout Switzerland in the planning and implementation of events, trade fairs or office solutions. As part of the Europe-wide Rent.Group, we create unforgettable events with atmosphere and are looking for a committed Account Manager in Sales & Event (m/f/d). Your mission: As an Account Manager in Sales & Event (m/f/d), you are the first point of contact for our customers – from the first contact to the successful execution of their event. You know how to build customer relationships, develop creative concepts and present our products convincingly. Your tasks: Acquisition and development of new customers Independent planning, calculation and execution of projects – from the concept phase to successful implementation Preparation of offers and order processing taking into account profitability and customer satisfaction Collaboration with our logistics and design team Your profile: Experience in sales, ideally in the event industry, hospitality or design environment Strong customer orientation, communication skills & negotiation skills Structured, goal-oriented and entrepreneurial way of working with a high sense of responsibility Enjoyment of design, trends and innovative event concepts Very good knowledge of MS Office and ideally experience with CRM systems Fluent German skills in spoken and written form are mandatory, French or English skills are desirable Driving licence category B What we offer: A dynamic, creative environment with flat hierarchies Exciting projects with renowned customers from business, culture and politics High personal responsibility & scope for design Direct influence & short decision-making paths Development prospects Performance-based bonus Ready to rethink events? Then we look forward to your application! Your contact person is Vanessa Dittmann.
